Subject: MAP: Draft mutual action plan & timeline options — Redwood Inference / Lumina Health

Hi Sofia / Raj —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. As promised, please find an initial draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached and summarized below. The goal here is to align on milestones, owners, and a realistic target close date so we can coordinate internal approvals and set expectations.

Quick discovery recap (from our call):
- Use case: embedding search + answers for provider portal (patients + clinicians) — primary KPI is reduce average support ticket resolution time by 30%.
- Success criteria: high-quality responses (human evaluation), sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for common queries, integration with existing SSO and data governance.
- Primary stakeholders: Sofia (PM), Raj (IT/security), procurement TBD, Redwood AE: Marissa, Redwood Solutions: Aditya.

Draft MAP (milestones & responsibilities) — two timeline options below:
1) Initial setup & evaluation
   - Kickoff & environment access: Mar 16–20 (Customer: share dev environment credentials; Redwood: provide onboarding doc)
   - POC dataset ingest & baseline eval: Mar 23–Apr 6 (Customer: supply sample dataset; Redwood: run baseline & initial tuning)
2) Security & procurement
   - Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange: Apr 7–Apr 21 (Customer: complete questionnaire; Redwood: provide SOC2 report and audit logs extract)
   - Procurement & contract review: Apr 14–Apr 28 (Customer: legal/procurement reviews; Redwood: provide SOW & standard terms)
3) Pilot & validation
   - Pilot run & user testing: Apr 29–May 12 (Customer: run pilot with X users; Redwood: monitor and tune)
4) Close / rollout
   - Final agreement & go/no-go: May 13–May 15 (Target close date option A)

Option B (extended security window) — pushes final close to May 31:
- Move Security & procurement window by 2 weeks + extend pilot by 1 week.

Dependencies / open items:
- Procurement contact at Lumina (who should be included on contract threads?)
- Final dataset sample (format + size) — Raj to confirm
- Security reviewer availability — if additional time is needed we should use Option B

Attachments: MAP-draft-LuminaHealth-v1.xlsx (initial milestone sheet), Discovery-notes-LuminaHealth.pdf (call notes).

Asks:
- Can you confirm the list of stakeholders (procurement/legal contact + any other approvers)?
- Which timeline option looks feasible (Option A: target close by 2026-05-15, or Option B: target close by 2026-05-31)?
- Any other dependencies we missed?

I’ve cc’d Aditya — he’ll own technical onboarding & the POC run. We can update the attached MAP after you confirm stakeholders and timing. Happy to jump on a 20-minute follow-up if helpful.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
